spans.s:
Side,Ⓒs.ⒹpArSvaH-rSva; pakza, in all senses; kukziH, pArSva-pakza-BAgaH; ‘left s(ide)’ vAmAMgaM, vAmapArSvaH; ‘opposite s(ide)’ vi-prati-pakzaH; ‘first s(ide)’ (of arguments) pUrvapakzaH; uttarapakzaH, &c.; ‘at oneʼs s(ide)’ pArSvataH, pArSve; ‘staying at the s(ide)’ pArSvagata-sTita.
Ⓑ
 2 prAMtaH, sImA, upAMtaM, aMtaH.
Ⓑ
 3 (Of a mountain) utsaMgaH, kawakaH-kaM, nitaMbaH.
Ⓑ
 4 BAgaH; ‘outer s(ide)’ bAhyaBAgaH; pUrvaBAgaH, &c.
Ⓑ
 5 (Direction) diS-SA; gen. ex. by tra, taH affixed; ‘on both s(ide)s’ uBayataH, uBayatra; ‘on the other s(ide)’ parataH, pAre; ‘on the left s(ide)’ vAmataH; ‘on all s(ide)s’ sarvatra, sarvataH, viSvataH, samaMtAt, samaMtataH, caturdikzu; ‘s(ide) by s(ide)’ pArSvApArSvi.
Ⓑ
 6 (Party, faction) pakzaH; ‘one of the opposite s(ide)’ vi-prati-pakzaH; ‘of the same s(ide)’ sapakzaH, svapakzIyaH, svapakzAvalaMbin m.; ‘relations on the fathers s(ide)’ pitfpakzAH bAMDavAH.
Ⓑ
 7 (In geometry) BujaH, pArSvaH, dos m. n., bAhuH; (of a river) pAraH-avAraH; ‘s(ide)-long’ vakra, tiraScIna, upAMga-sAci-tiryak in comp.; (adv.) pArSvataH, tiryak, sAci, tiraH; ‘s(ide) long look’ nayanopAMtavilokitaM, sAcivI-kzaRaM, apAMgadfzwi f., tiryagdfzwiH, kawAkzaH; ‘s(ide) look’ apAMgadarSanaM, kawAkzaH; &c.; ‘s(ide) ways’ ‘s(ide)-wise’ tiraScInaM, tiryak, tiraH.
Ⓔa.ⒹpArSva, pakza in comp.; pArSvasTa, pArSvika-pAkzika- (kI f.); ‘s(ide) breeze’ pakzavAtaH, pakzadvAraM, &c.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓ‘to be on the s(ide) of’ pakze BU, pakzaM grah 9 U or ASri 1 U or A-ava-laMb 1 A; ‘one who s(ide)s’ pakzyaH.
Ⓝ[Sid]er, Sidesman,Ⓒs.ⒹpakzapAtin m., pakzIyaH, pakzodgrAhin m. See Partizan.

Sidle,Ⓒv. i.Ⓓtiryak gam 1 P or yA 2 P.
Ⓝ[Sidl]ing,Ⓒa.Ⓓtiryaggati f.
